env.SETUP:
# lessons 006 and 015 test SoftUni's Student Registry app, which is no longer hosted, so run it locally on port 8080
git clone -q https://github.com/nakov/MVC-app-integration-tests-example-mocha.git "$RUNNER_TEMP/student-registry"
cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/student-registry" && git checkout -q 199394948c8a39edf1b7f0dd386a4aaf5787c6d7 && npm install --no-audit --no-fund
nohup npm start > app.log 2>&1 &
curl --silent --fail --retry 15 --retry-connrefused --retry-delay 1 http://localhost:8080/ > /dev/null
